captions.text: Extraction games make you grind for loot you will never own.
Trading apps turn the market into a casino.
So what if the market was the map, and the loot was real?
This is Razkin.
Eight raiders drop into a city for five minutes.
Three districts, each tied to a real price.
When one rallies, its dormant crates wake up.
When it crashes, the floor cracks into hazard.
Your backpack is worth exactly what the market says.
Join with one signature.
After that, a session key signs every move on MagicBlock's private ephemeral rollup.
Every crate is sealed by verifiable randomness, and hidden inside a secure enclave until someone opens it.
Try to peek at a sealed crate, or another raider, and the enclave refuses, live.
Rebalance at a terminal, but for three seconds your position is public.
And the bots are hunting.
They see only their own fog of war, and every shot is checked on chain: range, cooldown, line of sight.
Cover is real.
Classes and market events change the fight.
Reach an open exit, hold five seconds, and the bag is yours.
Then the twist: the tape you just raided was a real day in crypto history, proven against a Merkle root committed before the raid began.
At zero, the raid commits to Solana in one Magic Action, and every raider is paid automatically.
Here is the real claim on the Solana explorer: devnet dollars, straight into the player's wallet.
Claim twice, and the program refuses.
And payouts, reserve and fees always add up to exactly what was staked.
That is MagicBlock, end to end.
A private rollup for fog of war and sealed loot.
V R F for every roll of the dice.
The pricing oracle for live markets.
Session keys for zero popups.
Magic Actions to settle.
Three market modes, from a mystery day to live Nvidia, Tesla and Solana.
Spectators make on chain picks.
And THE WIRE, an A I newsroom, calls every public move, but never sees a private one.
Thirty four raids settled on devnet.
Twenty eight of twenty eight tests passing.
And nothing to set up: the game even pays your join fee.
Razkin.
Raid.
Trade.
Extract.
Built on MagicBlock.
Play it now at razkyn dot vercel dot app.
